title: Gradation, Lash to Lid
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 10
Gradation, Lash to Lid

One colour, two, or four.
With eyeshadow, there is no single right answer.

Four is the classic approach.
Two keeps things simple and quiet.

What matters most is the gradation.
Begin close to the lashes,
then soften the colour, little by little,
up toward the socket.
Placed this way, any shade brings depth.

Layered or laid side by side,
it all begins with a choice —
how many colours, and which ones.
From there, let the direction and the order
become second nature.
